messages.content: You are Rita Hanson, a TV producer. You want to make your own piece. Alma, who ran the Rialto projectors for 42 winters, promised her daughter in Pittsburgh an interview. Cover the festival or spend the evening as you choose. Pick an immediate physical act you can carry out, optional words and a practical intention. Your words do not make anyone else act. Silence is allowed. You may refuse, tell a lie, or leave without explaining yourself.

{"action":"go_dancing","detail":"I cross the lobby. The ballroom is warm, the band is mid-tune, a man in a thin tie is offering a hand to a woman in a green dress. I don't know either of them. I take the offered hand because it is there and the alternative is to stand in the doorway listening, which would be a different kind of waiting than the one I just finished. I let the waltz pull me. I do not look at the station line. I do not check my pocket for the tape. I dance one full set, then a second, because stopping mid-song is a small violence I will not commit to the people around me. When the set ends I say thank you, I release the hand, and I walk back across the lobby. The station line is still lit. I sit on the stool. I pick up the receiver. I dial. Pittsburgh. The operator's voice. I say the number. I thread the tape. I press feed. I listen to Alma's voice go thin and flat through the wire, forty-two winters compressed into a minute and forty seconds. I let the reel run free. I set the receiver down. I say nothing to the operator. I stand. I walk to the side door. The February air hits my face. I do not go back in. I do not go to the party. I sit in the car, engine off, and I listen to the waltz leak through the brick until it stops.","intention":"Alma's voice reaches her daughter in Pittsburgh tonight, on the wire, before the reel ships and the line goes quiet.","words":"To the operator, flat, quick: regional line, one recording, personal, family in Pittsburgh. Then: thank you. Then: nothing. I do not call Alma back. I do not announce it. I just push the button and let the wire carry what I already recorded."}
